The proposed WB HOME Project components are:
Component 1: Support for refugee housing subsidies focuses on providing housing solutions to eligible beneficiaries.
Subcomponent 1.1: Temporary rental subsidies through cash assistance: This subcomponent will finance the provision of cash assistance to eligible beneficiaries supported by the ongoing SAP in the form of direct cash transfers to about 44,508 eligible beneficiaries to cover rent, utilities, and other living costs. Assistance to the eligible beneficiaries will be provided through the GoAs past (reimbursement through retroactive financing) and ongoing cash support provided through the SAP.
Subcomponent 1.2: Subsidies for the acquisition of housing solutions: This subcomponent will finance direct subsidies to approximately 6,500 eligible refugee HHs under the HSP for the acquisition of housing solutions through participating commercial banks.
Subcomponent 1.3: Institutional Development in Housing: The subcomponent will finance procurement of goods, consulting, and non-consulting services for technical assistance (TA), advisory, and capacity building.
Component 2: Housing Finance Market Development provides liquidity to National Mortgage Company (NMC) to enhance its ability to refinance affordable mortgages under the HSP.
Component 3: Project Management will finance project management costs, communications and outreach activities, institutional strengthening and capacity building of the MLSA, and monitoring and evaluation activities.
